shortDescription: A smart-money wallet beginning with 0x32c spent $19.62 million on-chain to buy 8,773.52 ETH three hours ago, at an average cost of $2,236.75 per ETH. According to Foresight News, citing monitoring by @ai_9684xtpa, the wallet previously bought 7,543 ETH at the March low of $2,048.69.
